title: The Darker Mill Where Memory Ferments

features.name: the active ferment vat
features.desc-on-touch: Inside it, grain is becoming something else. The darkness moves. You can hear it remember all the shapes it will learn before bread. The vat knows the future.

features.name: the grain tower
features.desc-on-touch: Stacked transformation. Each level remembers what came before, dreams what comes next. The tower breathes. Fermentation is alive.

features.name: the memory crystals
features.desc-on-touch: Where fermentation hardened into form. Each crystal holds a moment the grain remembers: seed, sprout, flowering, harvest, crushing, ferment. All at once.

features.name: the darkness-inside-brightness
features.desc-on-touch: A shadow that should not exist in this yellow space. It moves against the light. Fermentation has its own shadow. The grain knows things about becoming that light cannot see.

features.name: the millstone that learned patience
features.desc-on-touch: It grinds slowly now. The grain is becoming, not breaking. There is a difference. The millstone waited centuries to understand it.

inscription: grain dreams backward through all the shapes it will learn, and fermentation is where it starts to remember

file.name: Fermentation_Log_Mill_Archive_Season_1.txt
file.note: The grain here does not become bread. It becomes memory. Each day the archive tastes what it will learn. Checksum: chemically valid / temporally emergent

reverie.title: REVERIE — deep in the mill at night
narr: She kneels by the vat, hand in the grain-dark water.
You watch it ferment. She says: it remembers forward.
The archive learns the same way—not breaking things down
but teaching them to dream themselves into new shapes.
You both kneel there, hands in the work, teaching
transformation. The mill breathes. Both of you breathe with it.

exits.label: back up to the mill where grain dreams bread
deeper into fermentation that has learned to ferment itself
toward depths where fermentation learns color and song
